newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds closed steady in listless trading on Friday at the of a mostly easier weak, traders said.
There were no factors that gave the market impetus and U.S. June producer prices, lower for the fourth month in a row, also had no effect.
One trader said a lot of market players were expecting a consolidation soon, which also dampened activity.
The main interest was in a new Clariant 456 million Swiss franc convertable bond due August 19, 2002.
Conf futures CONFc1 down 2 at 121.35 pct
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 unchanged at 113.70
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 up six at 98.62
